title: Dining out · 餐厅点餐
sentences: Do you have a table for two?
请问有两个人的位子吗？
We have a reservation under Chen.
我们用陈这个名字订了位。
Could we sit by the window?
我们可以坐在窗边吗？
Could I see the menu, please?
请给我看一下菜单好吗？
What do you recommend?
你推荐什么？
Is this dish spicy?
这道菜辣吗？
Does this contain peanuts?
这道菜含花生吗？
I'd like the chicken, please.
我想要鸡肉这道菜。
Could I have it without onions?
可以不放洋葱吗？
Could we get some water?
能给我们一些水吗？
Could we have another minute?
能再给我们一分钟吗？
Everything tastes great.
每道菜都很好吃。
Could we get this to go?
这份可以打包吗？
Could we split the bill?
我们可以分开结账吗？
Can I pay by card?
我可以刷卡吗？

title: Hotel check-in · 酒店入住
sentences: I have a reservation for tonight.
我预订了今晚的房间。
The booking is under my name.
预订是用我的名字登记的。
Could I check in now?
我现在可以办理入住吗？
May I see your passport?
我可以看一下您的护照吗？
Is breakfast included?
房费包含早餐吗？
What time is breakfast served?
早餐几点供应？
Could I have a quiet room?
可以给我一间安静的房间吗？
Is there Wi-Fi in the room?
房间里有无线网络吗？
What's the Wi-Fi password?
无线网络密码是什么？
Where is the elevator?
电梯在哪里？
Could I leave my luggage here?
我可以把行李寄存在这里吗？
The air conditioner isn't working.
空调不工作了。
Could someone take a look at it?
可以请人来看一下吗？
Is late checkout possible?
可以延迟退房吗？
I'd like to check out, please.
我想办理退房。

title: Shopping · 逛店购物
sentences: I'm just looking, thanks.
我只是看看，谢谢。
Do you have this in another size?
这个有别的尺码吗？
Do you have this in blue?
这个有蓝色的吗？
Can I try this on?
我可以试穿一下吗？
Where is the fitting room?
试衣间在哪里？
This is a little too small.
这个有点太小了。
How much does this cost?
这个多少钱？
Is there a discount on this?
这个有折扣吗？
Is this the final price?
这是最终价格吗？
I'll take this one.
我要这个。
Can I pay with my phone?
我可以用手机支付吗？
Could I get a receipt?
能给我一张收据吗？
What's the return policy?
退货政策是什么？
Can I exchange this if it doesn't fit?
如果不合适，我可以换货吗？
Could you put this in a bag?
可以帮我装进袋子吗？

title: Developer daily work · 开发日常
sentences: What are you working on today?
你今天在做什么？
I'm finishing the login flow.
我正在完成登录流程。
I pushed the latest changes.
我已经推送了最新改动。
Could you review my pull request?
你能帮我审一下拉取请求吗？
The build is still running.
构建还在运行。
The tests are passing locally.
测试在本地都通过了。
I can reproduce the bug.
我能复现这个问题。
I haven't found the root cause yet.
我还没找到根因。
I'm blocked by the API change.
接口变更把我卡住了。
Can we pair on this after lunch?
午饭后我们能一起看一下吗？
I'll update the ticket.
我会更新工单。
This should be ready by tomorrow.
这个应该明天能完成。
I need to check the logs first.
我得先看一下日志。
Let's keep the change small.
我们尽量把这次改动控制得小一些。
Could you share the test case?
你能分享一下测试用例吗？
I'll add a regression test.
我会补一个回归测试。
Let's deploy it after the review.
评审后再部署吧。
I'll let you know when it's done.
完成后我会告诉你。

title: Requirements and planning · 需求与排期
sentences: What problem are we trying to solve?
我们要解决什么问题？
Who is the main user for this feature?
这个功能的主要用户是谁？
Can we clarify the acceptance criteria?
我们能明确一下验收标准吗？
What happens when the request fails?
请求失败时会怎样？
Do we need to support older devices?
我们需要支持旧设备吗？
Is this in scope for this release?
这个在本次发布范围内吗？
Let's break this into smaller tasks.
我们把它拆成更小的任务吧。
What's the priority of this issue?
这个问题的优先级是什么？
I think this will take two days.
我觉得这需要两天。
The estimate depends on the API design.
工期估算取决于接口设计。
Could we ship a simpler version first?
我们可以先发布一个简化版吗？
What are the biggest risks?
最大的风险有哪些？
We should confirm the data format early.
我们应该尽早确定数据格式。
This depends on the design team.
这需要设计团队配合。
Let's agree on the deadline.
我们来确定截止时间吧。
We can revisit this next sprint.
下一个迭代我们可以重新讨论这个。
I'll document the open questions.
我会记录待确认的问题。
Let's make sure everyone has the same context.
我们确认一下大家掌握的信息一致。

title: Team meetings · 团队会议
sentences: Can everyone hear me?
大家能听到我说话吗？
I'll share my screen.
我来共享屏幕。
Let's start with a quick update.
我们先快速同步一下进展。
Yesterday I worked on the API.
昨天我在开发接口。
Today I'll focus on the frontend.
今天我会主要做前端。
I'm waiting for feedback from QA.
我在等测试团队的反馈。
Could you walk us through the change?
你能带大家过一下这次改动吗？
I have a question about the edge case.
我想问一下边界情况。
Sorry, could you repeat that?
抱歉，你能再说一遍吗？
Let me add some context.
我补充一点背景。
I agree with that approach.
我同意这个方案。
I see one potential risk.
我看到一个潜在风险。
Can we take this discussion offline?
我们可以会后单独讨论这个吗？
What's the next step?
下一步是什么？
Who will own this task?
这个任务由谁负责？
I'll send out the meeting notes.
我会发会议纪要。
Let's check in again on Friday.
我们周五再同步一次。
Thanks, everyone. That's all from me.
谢谢大家，我就说到这里。

title: Code review · 代码评审
sentences: Could you take a look at this pull request?
你能看一下这个拉取请求吗？
The change is smaller than it looks.
这次改动比看起来要小。
Can you explain why this is needed?
你能解释一下为什么需要这样做吗？
I think this case needs a test.
我觉得这个情况需要测试覆盖。
What happens if this value is missing?
如果这个值缺失会怎样？
Could we use a clearer name here?
这里能换个更清楚的名字吗？
This logic is duplicated in two places.
这段逻辑在两个地方重复了。
Can we move this into a helper?
我们能把它抽到辅助函数里吗？
I like the simpler approach.
我更喜欢这个简单的方案。
This might affect existing users.
这可能会影响现有用户。
Have we checked the migration path?
我们检查过迁移路径了吗？
Please add a short comment here.
请在这里加一条简短注释。
Good catch, I'll fix that.
发现得好，我会修正。
I've addressed your comments.
我已经处理了你的评审意见。
Could you review the latest commit?
你能看一下最新提交吗？
This looks good to me.
我觉得这版可以。
I'll approve once the tests pass.
测试通过后我会批准。
Thanks for the review.
谢谢你的评审。

title: Debugging and incidents · 排障与线上故障
sentences: When did the issue start?
这个问题是什么时候开始的？
Can you reproduce it consistently?
你能稳定复现吗？
It only happens in production.
它只在生产环境发生。
The error rate is going up.
错误率正在上升。
Let's check the application logs.
我们看一下应用日志。
I think the database is the bottleneck.
我觉得瓶颈在数据库。
The service is timing out.
服务正在超时。
Can we roll back the last release?
我们能回滚上一次发布吗？
I'll take the lead on the incident.
这次故障我来牵头处理。
Please post updates in the incident channel.
请在故障频道同步进展。
We have a temporary workaround.
我们有一个临时绕过方案。
The fix is ready for review.
修复已经可以评审了。
Let's test the fix in staging first.
先在预发布环境测试修复吧。
The error rate is back to normal.
错误率恢复正常了。
We should write a postmortem.
我们应该写一份事后复盘。
What was the root cause?
根因是什么？
How can we prevent this next time?
下次怎样避免这个问题？
Let's add an alert for this condition.
我们给这种情况加一个告警吧。

title: High-frequency tech terms · 高频技术词
sentences: The deadline is next Friday.
截止时间是下周五。
This feature has a dependency on the API.
这个功能依赖接口。
We need to reduce the latency.
我们需要降低延迟。
The service needs to scale.
这个服务需要能扩容。
Let's cache the result.
我们把结果缓存起来吧。
The data is stored locally.
数据保存在本地。
This change is backward compatible.
这个变更向后兼容。
The migration should be reversible.
迁移应该可以回退。
We need to handle this edge case.
我们需要处理这个边界情况。
The request failed validation.
这个请求没有通过校验。
Let's add an index to this table.
我们给这张表加一个索引吧。
The endpoint requires authentication.
这个接口需要身份验证。
The release is blocked by a regression.
这次发布被回归问题阻塞了。
We should monitor the error rate.
我们应该监控错误率。
The client retries the request.
客户端会重试请求。
We need to avoid duplicate writes.
我们需要避免重复写入。
This function has a side effect.
这个函数有副作用。
Let's make the operation idempotent.
我们让这个操作具备幂等性吧。

title: Interview: experience · 面试经历表达
headingZh: 面试：项目经历与团队合作
sentences: Could you tell me about yourself?
你能介绍一下自己吗？
I've been working as a software engineer for three years.
我做软件工程师已经三年了。
My main focus has been backend development.
我主要从事后端开发。
I worked on a high-traffic service.
我做过一个高流量服务。
I was responsible for the API design.
我负责接口设计。
The biggest challenge was reliability.
最大的挑战是可靠性。
I worked closely with product and design.
我和产品、设计团队密切合作。
We reduced the response time by half.
我们把响应时间缩短了一半。
I learned to communicate risks early.
我学会了尽早沟通风险。
Could you describe a difficult bug you solved?
你能讲一个自己解决过的难题吗？
I started by reproducing the issue.
我先从复现问题入手。
Then I checked the logs and metrics.
然后我检查了日志和指标。
I found the root cause in the cache layer.
我在缓存层找到了根因。
I added a test to prevent a regression.
我补了测试以防问题再次出现。
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate.
讲讲你和同事有不同意见的一次经历。
I listened to their concerns first.
我先听取了对方的顾虑。
We compared the trade-offs and ran a small experiment.
我们比较了取舍并做了一个小实验。
In the end, we agreed on a simpler design.
最后我们就一个更简单的设计达成了共识。

title: Interview: technical · 技术面试高频表达
sentences: Could you walk me through your approach?
你能讲一下你的思路吗？
Let me clarify the requirements first.
我先确认一下需求。
What are the expected input constraints?
输入规模和约束是什么？
Can I assume the input is valid?
我可以假设输入是有效的吗？
I'll start with a straightforward solution.
我先从一个直接的方案开始。
The time complexity is linear.
时间复杂度是线性的。
This uses extra memory for the hash map.
这里用哈希表占用了一些额外内存。
We can trade memory for speed.
我们可以用空间换时间。
Let me test a few edge cases.
让我测试几个边界情况。
What happens when the input is empty?
输入为空时会怎样？
I would add an index for this query.
我会为这个查询加一个索引。
We can partition the data by user ID.
我们可以按用户 ID 对数据分区。
The cache may become stale.
缓存可能会过期。
How would you handle a sudden traffic spike?
你会如何应对流量突增？
I'd measure the bottleneck before optimizing.
我会先测量瓶颈再优化。
We need a fallback if the service fails.
服务失败时需要一个后备方案。
Could I take a moment to think?
可以给我一点时间思考吗？
I haven't used that tool, but here's how I'd learn it.
我没用过那个工具，但我会这样学习它。

title: Interview: ask the team · 面试反问
sentences: What does a typical day look like on this team?
这个团队典型的一天是怎样的？
How is the engineering team organized?
工程团队是怎么组织的？
What are the most important projects right now?
现在最重要的项目是什么？
How do you decide technical priorities?
你们如何确定技术工作的优先级？
What is your code review process?
你们的代码评审流程是什么？
How often do you deploy?
你们多久部署一次？
How do you handle production incidents?
你们如何处理生产故障？
What does onboarding look like?
新人入职流程是怎样的？
How do engineers share knowledge?
工程师之间如何分享知识？
What would success look like in the first three months?
入职前三个月做到什么算成功？
What are the biggest challenges for this role?
这个岗位最大的挑战是什么？
How do product and engineering work together?
产品和工程团队如何合作？
Is there time for improving technical debt?
团队有时间处理技术债吗？
How do you support professional growth?
团队如何支持个人成长？
What do you enjoy most about working here?
你最喜欢在这里工作的哪一点？
Is there anything you'd like me to clarify?
还有什么需要我进一步说明的吗？
What are the next steps in the interview process?
面试流程的下一步是什么？
Thank you for your time today.
感谢你今天抽出时间。
